correctness.rationale: The cardinal-hat Gram operator has an invertible positive Fourier symbol and an exact alternating geometric inverse. Orthogonalization of the inserted tent gives a nonzero rank-one complement whose nodal values, positive squared energy, exact absolute integral including both infinite geometric tails, and spatial maximum are computed explicitly. Algebraic reduction yields the rational norm profile; differentiating gives a strictly positive derivative on the entire admissible parameter interval. A standalone 590-assertion checker verifies critical exact identities plus independent finite-section and cellwise-integral comparisons. Infinite claims are proved analytically rather than inferred from finite data.

value.rationale: The exact endpoint norm of the one-knot orthogonal projection increment is a natural sharp sensitivity quantity for adaptive L2 spline refinement; it governs the largest bounded-data coefficient contribution of a newly inserted knot. The formula and strict midpoint maximum characterize an entire continuously parameterized family rather than arbitrary samples, distinguish old-point and midpoint refinement, and are not implied by individual whole-projector Lebesgue norms. Its value is a self-contained sharp stability classification, not a claim to a downstream global convergence theorem.
